items.summary: Evolved PARALLAX from provenance inventory into a causal AION-frame fingerprint and historical analog layer with future-evidence rejection, source-balanced distance, provenance-preserving axes, outcome gating, and sensor/source ablation.
items.detail: The atlas consumes availability-gated AION frames, rejects future rows instead of hiding them, and remains research-only with no execution authority.

checks.name: AION frame causality
checks.detail: Regression rejects future evidence and verifies normalized price, depth and macro lineage.

checks.name: balanced analog distance
checks.detail: Source-balanced distance prevents a wide sensor family from dominating by column count.

items.summary: Added receipt-time microstructure journaling, deterministic depth replay, sequence-gap invalidation, provider recovery semantics, and an explicit evidence-capability bridge.
items.detail: The bridge forbids numeric tier translation between incompatible evidence taxonomies and keeps execution authorization false.

checks.name: gap/recovery regression
checks.detail: Tests cover future receipt hiding, depth-gap invalidation, provider recovery, capability mapping, and tamper detection.

items.summary: Restored and hardened ATHENA's stricter causal advisory journal and outcome-gated competence memory after detecting a weaker overwrite during branch reconciliation.
items.detail: Actual ingestion time is the hard visibility boundary; sequence gaps, blocked source-quality flags, production-plane learning, missing OOD evidence, future outcome availability, and premature recording all fail closed.

checks.name: causal receipt boundary
checks.detail: Tests distinguish provider availability from actual local ingestion.

checks.name: gap and quality abstention
checks.detail: Sequence gaps and identity-unverified evidence force abstention until valid recovery.

checks.name: learning OOD fail-closed
checks.detail: Missing OOD detector defaults to maximally OOD; production-plane updates are rejected.

items.detail: This integration is intentionally outside asset, timeframe, chart-construction, sub-minute, broker-routing, and order-execution ownership.
